For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shrawan Kumar, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/08/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.132/2022, registered at Police Station Ambapura, District Banswara, for offences under Sections 363, 366, 344, 376(2)(n) & 376(3) IPC and Section 5()/6 of the POCSO Act.
Attention of the Court was drawn towards an affidavit sworn by prosecutrix stating inter alia that she was neither abducted nor subjected to sexual assault by the present petitioner.
It was brought to the notice of this Court that the prosecutrix has now attained majority and has also given birth to a child.
(2 of 2)
opennyai_summary.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prosecutrix voluntarily eloped with the present petitioner and is living with him out of her free will and volition.
opennyai_summary.18_August_2023__decision:
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.
It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Ganesh S/o Morechand arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.132/2022,
registered at Police Station Ambapura, District Banswara, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of FIR No.73/2022 lodged at Police Station Mahila Thana Barmer, Distt.
Barmer for offence under Sections 363, 328, 420, 467, 468, 376, 376D & 120-B of IPC and Section 67 of the I.T. Act.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: After hearing learned counsel for the petitioner and taking into consideration the material available on record, this Court is not inclined to quash the FIR.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to file representation alongwith relevant documents before the concerned Superintendent of Police within a period of fifteen days.
The Superintendent of Police shall take up all the facts as well as representation, if any, filed on behalf of the petitioner and complete the investigation by considering them strictly in (2 of 2) [CRLMP-4794/2023] accordance with law within a period of four weeks from the date of filing of the representation.
For a period of four weeks from today, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.73/2022 lodged at Police Station Mahila Thana Barmer, District Barmer.
The instant misc. petition filed by the petitioners is disposed of accordingly.
Stay petition is also decided accordingly.
